### Correcting the Day of Life at Admission {#sec-solution-18}

The day of life on the infection and procedure forms of an enrolment is calculated from the day of life at admission recorded on its admission form, so a wrong value there makes the day of life on those forms wrong too, and they have to be updated as described in @sec-solution-11 once it is corrected.
For an infant admitted from the delivery room or on the day of birth, the platform sets the day of life at admission to 1 itself, but only while the admission form is open for editing; a completed admission form keeps the value it held when it was completed.
If the admission form of such an infant records another day of life at admission, first reopen the admission form for editing (see @sec-solution-9), refresh the page as described in @sec-solution-11, which sets the value to 1, and complete the admission form again (see @sec-solution-8); then update the enrolment's infection and procedure forms.
